crossRefs.note: The Lord said to him, “Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one…
But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and…
Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’
For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
It will happen that whoever will call on Yahweh’s name shall be saved; for in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be…
Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.
For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”
to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call…
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help…

parallels.note: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

translations.bsb: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
translations.asv: And it shall be, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved.
